derivation: apparently from H2357 (חָוַר) (in the sense of H2352 (חוּר)); cavernous;
def: Chavran, a region East of the Jordan

occurrences.text: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
